log: FROM VERDICTS TO A SCHEME -- design, improve, upgrade
Reductions multiply only when they cut INDEPENDENT costs: how many solves, how big each
solve is, how many steps. Two on the same axis are alternatives, not partners.
Superposition is GATED on finite-amplitude linearity, because every Hessian is linear and
the operator-level result licenses nothing on its own.
